payload.title: User registration agent: processed emails not archived in Outlook
payload.body:
## Summary

After the user registration agent processes an inbox message and the user is successfully created in the database, the source email is **not** moved to archive (or otherwise removed from the inbox). The message remains in the inbox and appears as read in Outlook.

## Expected behavior

Once processing completes successfully and the user exists in our DB, the corresponding email should be archived (or moved out of the primary inbox) consistent with our intended workflow.

## Actual behavior

Emails stay in the inbox and show as read in Outlook.

## Context

- **Area:** `apps/mediapulse/agents/user-registration` (user registration agent)
- **Symptom:** Inbox not cleared/archived after successful user creation

## Notes

- Reproduction steps and environment (tenant, mailbox) can be added when investigated.
